messages:
Morgan: Quick sync  pre-launch X/LinkedIn flow for the webinar on Mar 26. Need assets, two caption variants, UTMs, and a thread reply plan.

Anya: I can do copy. Which tone for X A/B? Urgent vs conversational?

Samir: Creative asks: GIF 1200x628, 1:1 static, 15s 16:9 clip, two thumbnails. Keep X copy <220 chars.

Jamie: Assigned CR-5102. ETA Mon 17:00 PT for assets + both thumbnails.

Morgan: Schedule: Tue 11:00 PT X teaser; Tue 12:00 PT LinkedIn long-form; Wed 09:00 PT X reminder; Wed 30m prior live thread with 3 replies.

Theo: UTM pattern: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=webinar_mar26&utm_content={variant}. Add lead tags webinar:mar26 + source:social.

Riley: Will wire UTMs and SFDC tags. I'll create auto-DM for thread replies and an SDR 1-hour SLA for hot leads. Need final reg URL.

Anya: Drafts: Variant A (urgent): "See 3x faster inference in real apps. Register: <shortlink> #inference" Variant B (convo): "Want to cut inference cost without losing latency? Save your spot: <shortlink>" LinkedIn long-form coming.

Samir: Thread replies plan: 1) "Reply 'clip' for a 15s highlight." 2) cost breakdown link. 3) final register nudge. Prepare DM template for auto-send.

Riley: Auto-DM will ask one qualifier: "Which infra? (cloud/on-prem/mixed)" to prioritize.

Anya: Sent stat source (Bench-2026-v3) to LegalBot for review.

LegalBot: Will review the exact phrasing within 4 hours.

Morgan: Action recap: Jamie deliver assets Mon 17:00 PT (CR-5102); Anya lock captions + LinkedIn EOD; Samir draft replies + DM templates; Riley wire UTMs + smoke test Mon 18:30 PT; Theo emit thread_engaged flag. Flag slips here. :rocket:
